note: Model license/auth status may have changed since publication. Always verify the model card on HuggingFace before use, especially for commercial deployments.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-24B-Base
models.when_to_use: Largest open Hebrew base LLM. Use for high-quality Hebrew text generation, completion, downstream fine-tuning. Production-grade. Costly to run.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-24B-Thinking
models.when_to_use: Reasoning variant. Best Hebrew LLM in 2026 for complex Hebrew tasks including slang explanation, idiom interpretation, cultural-nuance questions, grammar judgments. Default for advanced Hebrew query/answer.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Base
models.when_to_use: Mid-size base model on Nemotron. Good balance accuracy/cost.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct
models.when_to_use: Instruction-tuned mid-size. Good general-purpose Hebrew instruction following.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Base
models.when_to_use: Compact model for edge / on-device. Use when latency or hardware are constrained.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Instruct
models.when_to_use: Compact instruction model. Edge or fast batch processing.

models.name: DictaLM-3.0-1.7B-Thinking
models.when_to_use: Compact reasoning variant. Use when reasoning needed but latency-bound.

models.name: DictaLM-2.0
models.when_to_use: Prior generation Mistral-based Hebrew LLM. NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM benchmark target — use this with TensorRT optimization for production deployment (see references/nvidia_tensorrt_optimization.md).

models.name: DictaLM-2.0-Instruct
models.when_to_use: Instruction variant of DictaLM-2.0. Recommended NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM deployment target for Hebrew chat at scale.

models.name: BEREL_3.0
models.when_to_use: Biblical / Rabbinic Hebrew. Use for religious / Talmudic / liturgical content. Switch to this for biblical-rabbinic variation mode.

models.name: BEREL
models.when_to_use: Earlier-generation BEREL for Early / Rabbinic Hebrew. Use if 3.0 is unavailable.

models.name: Hebrew-Gemma-11B-V2
models.when_to_use: Gemma-based Hebrew chat. Alternative to Dicta for chat/conversational. Gemma license applies.

models.name: Hebrew-Gemma-11B-Instruct
models.when_to_use: Instruction-tuned Gemma Hebrew. Good for instruction-following.

models.name: Hebrew-Gemma-11B
models.when_to_use: Base Gemma Hebrew. Foundation for fine-tunes.

models.name: Hebrew-Gemma-11B-V2-mlx-4bit
models.when_to_use: MLX-quantized Hebrew-Gemma for Apple Silicon. Use on Mac Studio / M-series GPU.

models.name: Hebrew-Mistral-7B
models.when_to_use: Mistral-based Hebrew base. Common foundation.

models.name: Hebrew-Mistral-7B-200K
models.when_to_use: Extended 200K context. Use for long-document analysis, full-book summarization, multi-document RAG.

models.name: Hebrew-Mistral-7B_Chat-GGUF
models.when_to_use: GGUF-quantized for llama.cpp / Ollama deployment. CPU-friendly.

models.name: Hebrew-Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1-GGUF
models.when_to_use: GGUF instruction variant for local CPU/GPU.

models.name: Hebrew-Mixtral-8x22B
models.when_to_use: Mixture-of-experts. Large-scale Hebrew. Production-grade with significant hardware (multi-GPU).

models.name: Hebrew-Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1
models.when_to_use: Community Mistral instruction fine-tune.

models.name: dictalm2.0-instruct-fine-tuned-alpaca-gpt4-hebrew
models.when_to_use: Alpaca-style instruction tuning on Hebrew. Good general instruction-following baseline.

models.name: Hebrew_Nemo
models.when_to_use: Mistral Nemo-based Hebrew. Mid-size alternative.

models.name: Hebrew-GPT

models.name: Hebrew-GPT2-345M-Stage

models.name: SmolLM-135M-FakyPedia-EngHeb

models.name: gemma-3_4b_hebrew-lyrics-finetune

models.name: hebrew-summarization-llm

models.name: hebrew_bible_ai

models.name: hebert-finetuned-hebrew-metaphor

models.name: t5-hebrew-translation

models.name: Llama-3.1-8b-Hebrew2SQL

models.name: hebrew_medical_ner_v5

models.name: whisper-large-v3-ct2

models.name: whisper-v2-d4

models.name: faster-whisper-v2-d4

models.name: pyannote-speaker-diarization-3.1

models.name: pyannote-segmentation-3.0

models.name: wav2vec2-xls-r-300m-hebrew

models.name: SIMS-Llama3.2-3B
models.when_to_use: Speech-language model 3B. Hebrew TTS / speech generation.

models.name: israwave
models.when_to_use: Community Hebrew TTS.

models.name: Zonos-Hebrew

models.name: hebrewTTS-orpheus3b

models.name: hebrew-orpheus-tts
models.when_to_use: Alternative Orpheus Hebrew TTS variant.

models.name: mms-tts-heb
models.when_to_use: Meta MMS TTS for Hebrew.

models.name: AlephBERT-base
models.when_to_use: Foundational Hebrew BERT (29.6K downloads). Use as base for fine-tuning.

models.name: heBERT
models.when_to_use: General-purpose Hebrew BERT. Alternative to AlephBERT for fine-tuning.

models.name: Legal-heBERT
models.when_to_use: Legal Hebrew. PRIMARY model for legal-technical variation mode. Use for contracts, legal opinions, statute interpretation.

models.name: DictaBERT
models.when_to_use: Modern Hebrew BERT. Generally outperforms AlephBERT on Hebrew NLP.

models.name: DictaBERT-large
models.when_to_use: Large DictaBERT. Use when accuracy is critical.

models.name: NeoDictaBERT
models.when_to_use: Next-generation DictaBERT. State-of-the-art Hebrew BERT.

models.name: NeoDictaBERT-bilingual
models.when_to_use: Hebrew-English bilingual BERT. PRIMARY for bilingual variation mode and EN↔HE retrieval.

models.name: AlephBertGimmel-base
models.when_to_use: Third-generation AlephBERT lineage.

models.name: MsBERT
models.when_to_use: Alternative DictaBERT variant.

models.name: HeRo
models.when_to_use: Hebrew RoBERTa. Alternative to BERT architectures.

models.name: LongHeRo
models.when_to_use: Long-context Hebrew RoBERTa. Use for documents over 512 tokens.

models.name: heBERT_NER
models.when_to_use: Hebrew NER (39K downloads). Standard for entity extraction.

models.name: dictabert-ner
models.when_to_use: DictaBERT NER. Modern alternative to heBERT_NER.

models.name: dictabert-large-ner
models.when_to_use: Large DictaBERT NER. Highest accuracy.

models.name: heBERT_sentiment_analysis
models.when_to_use: Hebrew sentiment (pos/neg/neu). Standard for sentiment tasks.

models.name: dictabert-sentiment
models.when_to_use: DictaBERT sentiment. Modern alternative.

models.name: xlm-r_hebrew_sentiment
models.when_to_use: Multilingual-based Hebrew sentiment.

models.name: hebEMO
models.when_to_use: Hebrew emotion detection across 8 categories (anger, fear, joy, sadness, anticipation, surprise, trust, disgust). PRIMARY for gender-emotional variation mode.

models.name: dictabert-morph
models.when_to_use: Hebrew morphological analysis. Used internally by grammar validator (gender, number, binyan).

models.name: dictabert-joint
models.when_to_use: Joint morphological-syntactic. Base for dictabert-parse fine-tunes.

models.name: dictabert-large-parse
models.when_to_use: Best-in-class Hebrew dependency parser. Use for syntactic analysis, agreement checking, smikhut detection.

models.name: dictabert-parse
models.when_to_use: Standard Hebrew parser. Lighter than large. PRIMARY for grammar validation (used by scripts/hebrew_validate.py).

models.name: dictabert-seg
models.when_to_use: Hebrew word segmentation. Pre-processing for parsing.

models.name: dictabert-lex
models.when_to_use: Lexical / lemma analysis. Find base form of inflected words.

models.name: dictabert-syntax
models.when_to_use: Syntactic feature identification.

models.name: dictabert-large-char-menaked
models.when_to_use: Hebrew nikud restoration (4.5K downloads). Use for ceremonial / religious / TTS-prep text.

models.name: dictabert-char
models.when_to_use: Character-level Hebrew BERT. For diacritization tasks.

models.name: hebrew_punctuation
models.when_to_use: Hebrew punctuation restoration. Modern Hebrew often lacks extensive punctuation — this fixes it.

models.name: dictabert-heq
models.when_to_use: Hebrew extractive QA. RAG retrieval over Hebrew documents.

models.name: hebert_parashoot
models.when_to_use: Hebrew reading comprehension.

models.name: hebrew-offensive-detection
models.when_to_use: Detect offensive Hebrew. Use for moderation, content filtering.

models.name: Offensive-Hebrew
models.when_to_use: Alternative offensive-Hebrew detector.

models.name: neodictabert-bilingual-embed
models.when_to_use: Bilingual Hebrew-English embeddings. PRIMARY for cross-lingual RAG / retrieval.

models.name: sentence-transformers-alephbert
models.when_to_use: Hebrew sentence embeddings (4.9K downloads). Standard for sentence-level retrieval.

models.name: sentence_transformers_alephbertgimmel_small
models.when_to_use: Smaller Hebrew sentence embeddings. Edge / low-latency.

models.name: opus-mt-en-he
models.when_to_use: English → Hebrew translation. Standard MT baseline.

models.name: opus-mt-tc-big-he-en
models.when_to_use: Hebrew → English large translation.

models.name: english-hebrew-translation
models.when_to_use: Bidirectional EN↔HE T5.

models.name: het5_summarization
models.when_to_use: Hebrew T5 summarization.

models.name: het5_small_summarization
models.when_to_use: Compact Hebrew summarizer.

models.name: cross_summarization_he_en
models.when_to_use: Hebrew → English cross-lingual summarization. Bilingual report generation.

models.name: testing-trOCR-hebrew-handwritten
models.when_to_use: TrOCR Hebrew handwriting. Use for handwritten Hebrew documents.

models.name: paleo-hebrew-mt5-post-ocr-processing
models.when_to_use: Paleo-Hebrew OCR post-correction.

models.name: paleo-hebrew-qwen3-vl-lora-post-ocr-processing
models.when_to_use: Vision-language for paleo-Hebrew. Archaeological / historical text.

models.name: mhubert-base-25hz
models.when_to_use: Multilingual HuBERT at 25Hz. Speech feature extraction baseline.

models.name: slam_scaled
models.when_to_use: Speech-language alignment. Hebrew speech understanding.

models.name: StresSLM
models.when_to_use: Stress-aware speech-language model. Prosody-sensitive Hebrew.

models.name: PAST
models.when_to_use: Prosody-aware speech model. Hebrew prosody.

models.name: hebrew_whisper
models.when_to_use: Community Hebrew Whisper project. Alternative ASR.

models.name: Hspell
models.when_to_use: Hebrew spell check + morphological analyzer. Academy-of-Hebrew compliant. CLI + Python wrapper. PRIMARY rule-based grammar tool.

models.name: YAP
models.when_to_use: Go-based Hebrew morphosyntactic parser. Alternative to DictaBERT-parse. Faster for batch processing.

models.name: HebMorph
models.when_to_use: Hebrew analyzer for Lucene/Elasticsearch. Use for Hebrew search index.

models.name: Dicta Nakdan
models.when_to_use: Professional Hebrew diacritization service. Adds nikud (vowels). Use for ceremonial / TTS-prep / liturgical text. Pro version at nakdanpro.dicta.org.il. API endpoint exists at /api.

models.name: Academy of the Hebrew Language
models.when_to_use: Authoritative source for Hebrew grammar rulings, terminology, spelling decisions. Use for resolving disputes; cite when establishing canonical forms.

models.name: Morfix
models.when_to_use: Hebrew dictionary + full conjugation tables. Quick lookup for binyan / gender / inflection.

models.name: Rav-Milim
models.when_to_use: Hebrew thesaurus. Synonym discovery and register-variant selection.

models.name: MILA Hebrew Corpus
models.when_to_use: Academic Hebrew NLP reference corpus. Historical baseline; less active.

models.name: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM Hebrew
models.when_to_use: Production Hebrew LLM optimization. Target: DictaLM-2.0 + TensorRT-LLM + Triton. FP16 / INT4 quantization. Use when deploying Hebrew LLM at scale on NVIDIA hardware. See references/nvidia_tensorrt_optimization.md.

models.name: DeepL API (HE↔EN)
models.when_to_use: Highest-quality EN↔HE neural translation. Use for content that must be culturally idiomatic. Requires API key. Paid tier for production.

models.name: DictaBERT Collection (17 models)
models.when_to_use: Full DictaBERT collection. Aggregate of all DictaBERT variants — use as discovery point for task-specific Hebrew BERTs.
